source: NHTSA vPIC makes and models API
approx_entries: 12372 makes (Count field of the fetched JSON)
organised_by: alphabetical by make name; GetModelsForMake and GetVehicleTypesForMake endpoints per make
fit: maker ledger; named forms (models per make)
notes: Free no-key API plus downloadable DB. Regulator-fed: includes trailer, motorcycle, RV and custom-shop makes beside OEMs; US market, noisy duplicate names.

organised_by: country, then extant or defunct
notes: Only makers with an article. Links to country lists (US, Europe, Asia, China) and List of car brands; use as the car maker spine.

organised_by: marque A-Z with model count, years of production and country; filters for body, engine, drive
notes: Lists active and gone makers; same name appears per country (Honda Indonesia vs Honda). Per-marque spec pages give model lines and years.

approx_entries: over 56,000 specs; about 300 brand names on the front page
organised_by: brand A-Z, then model, generation, engine
notes: Includes pre-war and obscure makes (Abbott Detroit, Wills Sainte Claire, Willys-Knight). Good for the defunct tail that Wikipedia lacks.

approx_entries: 57,000 automobiles (site home, from search excerpt); API page claims 350+ brands, 3,500+ models, 10,000+ generations
organised_by: brand, model, generation, modification
notes: Fetch returned only the page footer (script-built list); counts come from the site's own search excerpts. Re-check with a browser-grade fetch before harvesting.

organised_by: make, model, generation, platform, chassis code, car class, production years
notes: Full list is sold (about 71 USD); free sample covers 4 makes. Mostly post-WWII; no concept cars. Use only to cross-check coverage.

organised_by: maker, car name, body type, price, fuel economy; kei flag
notes: Current JDM new cars only, including kei and one-box. Pair with Goo-net used-car side for older models.

approx_entries: 3,065 model listings (page states 車種掲載台数)
organised_by: maker; model; ranking pages by type (kei, minivan, camping car, welfare vehicle, truck)
notes: Larger than Goo-net because it keeps discontinued models; its maker list includes imports (Koenigsegg, Fisker, Burstner).

source: Dongchedi brand directory (all China car brands)
organised_by: brand, then series (车系)
notes: Title is the all-brands article, but the fetch returned only a login shell. Treat as a lead; Autohome was not reached.

organised_by: brand, model, variant; filters body type, fuel, seats
notes: Indian market incl. defunct entries per brand (Cadillac page lists expired models). Sister site BikeDekho covers two-wheelers.

organised_by: region, then maker with country; links to American and dump-truck lists
notes: Heavy and light truck makers incl. defunct US names; sub-lists for US, electric and dump trucks. No model data.

approx_entries: 62 country subcategories; 83 trolleybus makers, 22 school-bus, 36 defunct bus makers pages (from category counts)
organised_by: category by country, school, electric, trolleybus, defunct
notes: Plus Buses by manufacturer (40 subcategories) and List of buses. Best open source for bus and coach builders.

organised_by: extant or extinct, then country
notes: Spine for motorcycle makers; defunct section is long. Companion list covers motor scooters and mopeds.

source: Wikipedia List of motor scooter manufacturers and brands
organised_by: in production vs historic; nationality; group notes
notes: Table with nationality and parent group; includes electric scooter makers (NIU, Vectrix) and defunct ones with museum references.

approx_entries: 550 brands and 40,000 models (page headline; sibling pages say 530 and 493)
organised_by: brand (with model counts), year 1894 to date, category (14), engine size
notes: Largest open motorcycle model list; includes veteran and vintage bikes and ATVs. Brand pages list every model-year as a row.

organised_by: brand, model; filters scooter, sports, cruiser, electric
notes: Covers Indian two-wheelers (Hero, Bajaj, TVS, Royal Enfield, Ather, Ola) that Western catalogues thin out; current models only.

source: Wikipedia List of bicycle brands and manufacturing companies
organised_by: alphabetical with country and defunct flags
notes: Notes who rebadges for whom (Giant, KHS, Cycleuropa). Companion lists exist for BMX, Australian and Japanese brands.

source: Wikipedia List of electric bicycle brands and manufacturers
organised_by: alphabetical with country
notes: Also lists electric unicycle makers; use for e-bike and e-micromobility makers and the Category:Electric cycle manufacturers (44 pages).

source: Wikipedia List of Japanese bicycle brands and manufacturers
organised_by: Japanese brands, manufacturers, foreign brands made in Japan
notes: Covers Panasonic, Bridgestone, Miyata, Araya and OEM-for-export brands (Nishiki, Univega). Marked as needing citations.

organised_by: alphabetical; flag marks component or accessory makers
notes: Registry-derived list with a flag separating bicycle makers from parts brands. Useful to split frame makers from component brands.

approx_entries: 141,738 bikes across 509 brands (their Data Services page)
organised_by: brand, model year, category and subcategory, e-bike flag
notes: Page list loads by script, brand filter via makerId in URL; best bicycle model-line catalogue with geometry and spec level.

organised_by: builder with country, model ranges, boat type (sail, power, inflatable, small boats), years built
notes: Gives the model ranges per builder and years active, including defunct yards. Strongest single boat-builder directory found.

organised_by: 3-letter MIC code, company, address, state
notes: Every builder that sells boats in the US, from Four Winns to one-man shops. Company names only (no models); filter by state.

organised_by: brand A-Z; boat type and class facets (sail classes, unpowered, PWC)
notes: Brand list also carries non-brand entries (Motorsailer, Narrowboat) so needs cleaning. Sail class facet lists cutter, ketch, sloop, trimaran, gulet.

approx_entries: over 11,600 sailboats, designers, builders and associations (about 9,300 production boats)
organised_by: boat name; searchable by LOA, rig, designer, builder, year
notes: Search results and builder list load by script and came back empty on fetch; star class record shows builder and association fields.

organised_by: Olympic, international, regional classes by dinghy, keelboat, multihull, board, kite, radio; former classes
notes: Class designs as named forms (470, Laser, J/24, Hobie 16). The official list at sailing.org/our-sport/world-sailing-classes filters by status and hull type but is script-built.

organised_by: kayak subtype (sit-on-top, inflatable, folding, surf ski, whitewater, packraft), manufacturer pages
notes: Page lists 40+ featured manufacturers; canoes, SUP and fishing kayaks are separate sections. Playak.com has an older model list.

approx_entries: 7,324 entries (ICAO search page, from search result); doc8643.com mirror says over 2,700 types
organised_by: manufacturer, model, designator, class (landplane, seaplane, amphibian, helicopter, gyrocopter, tiltrotor), engine type and count
notes: Official search page is script-built; full data needs registration or purchase. doc8643.com mirror browses by designator.

organised_by: designator A-Z with manufacturer and model names
notes: Open view of the ICAO designator list, includes gliders and light types (Schleicher ASG-32, Aeropract A-33). Lacks engine and class columns.

organised_by: Aircraft Reference file by make, model and series; engine reference file
notes: Daily CSV download (zip, about 60 MB) of every registered US aircraft type, including homebuilt and light sport; also Make/Model inquiry page.

organised_by: TC holder, product type (aircraft, rotorcraft, balloon, airship, engine, propeller)
notes: Lists TC holders from Airbus to small glider and balloon makers (Schleicher, Ballons Chaize, Ultramagic). Datasheet PDFs per type.

approx_entries: 474 aircraft over 40 pages; manufacturer list over about 4 pages of 100
organised_by: manufacturer, then model with stall, cruise, weight, price
notes: Ultralights, gyrocopters, homebuilts and microlight makers that FAA and EASA lists omit (Ace Autogyro, Aerolite 103).

organised_by: manufacturer, then aircraft; indexes by letter, by type (gliders, rotorcraft, civil) and by nation
notes: Includes military and historic types; separate List of gliders (by nationality) and rotorcraft. Needs a civil filter.

source: Jane's All the World's Aircraft digitised
organised_by: country, manufacturer, first-flight year, type
notes: Hobbyist transcription of Jane's yearbooks 1909 to 2009; fixed-wing mostly. Use for historic types only.

organised_by: make A-Z with listing counts; browse by type (Class A, B, C, towables)
notes: Long tail of small makers (1492 Coachworks, 27 North, Adam Trailers); also park models and truck campers.

organised_by: brand, range, model, layout
notes: Covers Swift, Bailey, Elddis, Eriba, Hobby, Knaus, Tabbert, Airstream. Motorhome and campervan brand pages sit alongside.

source: Out and About Live caravan buyer's guide
approx_entries: thousands of caravans over the past decade (page statement); about 100 manufacturers in the menu
organised_by: manufacturer, model range, model, year
notes: Longest UK list incl. German and French makes (Bürstner, Dethleffs, Caravelair) and teardrops; model names shown per range.

organised_by: class (A, B, C, fifth wheel, travel trailer, pop-up, truck camper) with length and weight bands and named makers
notes: Kind-level source for RV classes with size bands; names Winnebago, Jayco, Thor, Airstream, Lance, Oliver. Little model detail.

source: KBA Verzeichnis der Hersteller und Typen (SV 4.5)
organised_by: manufacturer code HSN then type code TSN; vehicle class code, axles, mass
notes: Regulator list of every type approved in Germany incl. trailers, tractors, machines and Italian, French, Danish firms. Companion SV 4.3 file exists.

approx_entries: unknown (more shown only to logged-in members)
organised_by: member categories: agricultural, auto hauler, boat, cargo, dump, horse, livestock, motorcycle, snowmobile, utility and others
notes: Trade association of makers of trailers under 26,000 lb GVWR; public view is limited. Category list is a ready kind list for trailers.

organised_by: alphabetical by letter
notes: Community list of European trailer makers by letter, no ranking; small and dated (2017) but names the car-trailer brands.

organised_by: brand (Shadow, Lakota, SMC, Featherlite, Exiss, Sundowner); category bumper pull, gooseneck, living quarters, stock
notes: Horse and stock trailer makers with category pages; the page is mostly adverts and links, so brand list is short.

approx_entries: about 60 makes listed (counted on the fetched page)
organised_by: make A-Z, then model and year
notes: Historic and current snowmobile makes from Alouette to Yukon King; data complete only for Arctic Cat, Polaris, Ski-Doo, Yamaha, John Deere.

organised_by: country, active vs defunct; sub-lists of British railway and early private builders
notes: Companion List of rolling stock manufacturers (fetched, by country, incl. US defunct car builders). Rail rolling stock is mostly commercial; check C-domain scope.

source: Carriage Association of America builders directory
organised_by: business with description, address, website
notes: Builders and restorers of horse-drawn carriages, carts and sleighs (Troyer, Meadowbrook, Great Northern Livery: 67 body styles). Little on model names.

source: Grace's Guide to British Industrial History
organised_by: index pages by category (cars, motorcycles, bicycles, aircraft, trucks, buses) and by company
notes: Best source for defunct British vehicle makers and their products; text under CC BY-SA. Category pages must be browsed individually.

organised_by: vehicle type to article linkages; parts brands
notes: Industry-standard parts catalogue; marketing page only, data is licensed. Use for the list of aftermarket brands and part categories.

organised_by: make, year, model, engine, then part group and part; manufacturer filter lists hundreds of part brands
notes: Make list runs from Abarth to Zundapp and includes motorcycles; page content loads by script. Fit of part to vehicle is the model/year tree.

organised_by: make, region (Japan, Europe, USA, Asia), then body/model code
fit: parts sub-family; named forms (OEM model codes)
notes: Gives OEM model and chassis codes for Japanese and some European makes; catalogue pages load by script.

organised_by: year, make, model, submodel; product classifications and brand table (BRAD)
notes: Fitment data standard behind US parts catalogues; documentation needs a free Auto Care login. Vehicle and brand tables are licensed.

organised_by: category (full-size, travel, jogging, double, all-terrain, travel system), brand, weight, fold
notes: Small but clean US model list with sources per spec and replaced-model flags. Not exhaustive; many EU brands (Bugaboo, Joolz, Hartan) thin.

organised_by: brand profiles
notes: Fetch returned only the intro text (brand cards load by script). BabyOne has an A-Z pram brand index but was not fetched.

approx_entries: 10 brands (Segway-Ninebot, GOTRAX, NAVEE, NIU, Apollo, Hiboy, Dualtron, Kaabo, EMOVE, InMotion)
organised_by: brand with models tracked and segment (commuter, budget, premium, performance)
notes: Small independent list of e-scooters with spec sheets from makers; electricscooterfinder.com claims a larger database but was not fetched.

approx_entries: about 66 type values on the page (S2 counted 68)
organised_by: one flat list: houses, flats, bungalows, character types (Riad, Trulli, Cave House, Longere, Gite), land, house boat, park home, garages
notes: Best single marketplace kind list; mixes legal forms with vernacular types. Search type maps to internal categories, so counts per type are not shown.

organised_by: detached, semi-detached, terraced, purpose-built flat, converted house, converted other building, commercial building, caravan or mobile structure
notes: Statistical class, not a market list; useful to anchor dwelling kinds. Equivalent standards: US ACS B25024, Japan Housing and Land Survey (S2).

organised_by: form, longhouse, other types (courtyard, riad, siheyuan, dacha), construction method (kit, prefab, manufactured)
notes: Main named-form spine for dwellings, with regional types (Geestharden house, Upper Lusatian house, Assam-type). Companion List of house styles covers appearance.

organised_by: residential, commercial, industrial, infrastructural, agricultural, institutional
notes: Wider than houses: agricultural buildings (granary, hayloft, stable, well house), religious, civic. Check each link for a real built form versus a function.

organised_by: hierarchy: single built works by function, residential structures, dwellings; terms in many languages
region_language: global; en, zh, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt
notes: Multilingual thesaurus with scope notes and RDF export. Vernacular architecture (ID 300068483) and historic houses nodes sit alongside.

source: FISH Thesaurus of Monument Types (Historic England)
organised_by: by function: domestic, agriculture, religious and funerary, commemorative, recreational, transport, defence
notes: Download as RDF at heritagedata.org. Funerary branch covers grave, cemetery and monument types; domestic branch covers house forms with dates.

source: Historic England National Farm Building Types
approx_entries: about 30 building types in the contents list
organised_by: alphabetical: barn, cart shed, granary, hay barn, stable, staddle barn, Dutch barn, dovecote, coach house, kennels, mill, malt house
notes: 39-page guide with consistent terms; incorporated in FISH thesaurus. Covers barns and outbuildings that G2 treats as buildings.

organised_by: flat type list: farmland, woodland, island, barn, building plot, vineyard, cave, bunker, shepherd's hut, glamping site
notes: Longest land and rural-property type menu found; includes structures (bunker, castle, airstrip). Use as the UK land kind list.

organised_by: property type facet (undeveloped, homesite, farms and ranches, recreational), housing type (cabin, barndominium, tiny home), land use, size band
notes: Counts per facet value shown on the page, so frequency data is free. Separate hunting, ranch and lake facets.

organised_by: residential (house, section, apartment, unit, townhouse, conversion, home and income); rural (dairy, dairy support, finishing, arable, horticulture, lifestyle)
notes: Trade-body definitions in the agent's own words; the rural list is a use-based farm-type scheme.

approx_entries: 6 primary classes; nested secondary and tertiary classes in the XLSX
organised_by: conservation, relatively natural production, dryland agriculture, irrigated agriculture, intensive uses, water
notes: Downloadable tables and a vocabulary service; the most detailed national land-use register found. Use classes, not property deals.

organised_by: alphabetical guide: cob, earthship, tiny home, yurt, houseboat, mobile and manufactured, modular, prefab
notes: Consumer guide that treats alternative dwellings as types; short on legal definitions. Pair with Wikipedia lists.

source: idealista guide to housing types in Spain
organised_by: unifamiliar (chalet, adosado, pareado, casa, masia, cortijo) versus plurifamiliar (piso, atico, duplex, loft, estudio)
notes: Gives Spanish vernacular terms with the one-family versus multi-family cut. Idealista listings also run in Italy and Portugal.

organised_by: new detached, used detached, new and used condominium (mansion), land, custom-built house; filters by floor plan and price
notes: Japanese portal type menu is short (detached, condominium, land); floor plan codes (1K to 5K+) are listed. Rental side adds mansion and apartment.

approx_entries: 20 ranked per page; list covers house makers and builders nationwide
organised_by: maker with views and inquiries score; filter by prefecture and feature (imported house, garage house, narrow house)
notes: Names Ichijo Koumuten, Tama Home, Sekisui House, Sekisui Heim, Sumitomo Forestry, Misawa, Toyota Home, Daiwa House. Per-maker pages give model lines and floor-area price.

approx_entries: unknown (about 30 manufacturers on the fetched page)
organised_by: manufacturer or lender, state filter
notes: Names Cavco, Champion, Clayton, Cavalier, Deer Valley, Fairmont, Fleetwood. A members-only directory also exists; no model lines on the page.

organised_by: state, then manufacturer
notes: State-by-state list of manufactured and modular home builders; builder pages carry model floor plans. State pages must be walked one by one.

organised_by: maker profile: range, price band, features; garden house kinds (Gartenlaube, Blockhaus, Grillhaus, Gartensauna, Teehaus)
notes: German garden-building makers (Karibu, Finnhaus Wolff, Biohort, Weka, Palmako, Lasita Maja with 500 models). Flags own-label brands.

organised_by: brand filter (Skanholz, Palmako, Biohort, weka, Karibu, Ximax, Konsta); product types Gartenhaus, Carport, Pavillon, Grillpavillon
notes: Retailer brand list plus named models (Keter Apex, Konsta 9x7). Own-label ranges (Garden Place, Konsta) need the retail own-label class.

organised_by: log cabins, summerhouses, garden offices, shed types (apex, pent, corner, potting, Dutch barn, alleyway), gazebos, pergolas, pub sheds
notes: Maker-retailer menu gives kinds for garden buildings; model line names are the Overlord, Apex families. UK counterpart to German catalogues.

organised_by: category (garages and carports, garden sheds, outbuildings), brand (Absco, Keter, Lifetime, EnduraShed), size and roof (reverse skillion, space saver)
notes: Brand-and-model rows with size and roof shape in the name; shows how steel shed ranges are named in Australia.

organised_by: builder with style: aluminium, fibreglass, pontoon, trailerable, luxury, custom; worldwide by region
notes: Enthusiast directory of houseboat builders (Bravada, Destination, Catamaran Cruisers, Sumerset); a separate manufacturers page ranks them. Dated and sponsor-led.

approx_entries: about 25 named pool models in the PDF
organised_by: shape (rectangle, freeform, spa, tanning ledge) then model with length, width and depth
notes: Example of pool-shell model names (Monaco, Fiji, Laguna, Cancun, Venice) from one maker; other shell makers (River Pools, Leisure Pools) not fetched.

source: Dignity Memorial types of cemetery property
organised_by: in-ground (individual, double-depth, family estates, urn gardens), aboveground (community and private mausoleums, columbaria, cremation pedestals, benches, boulders)
notes: Provider's own classification of burial space; matches PlotListings (7 interment options with capacity and price ranges).

organised_by: single, companion, family, lawn crypt, mausoleum crypt, private mausoleum, cremation niche, each with capacity, location and cost band; niche subtypes solid-front, glass-front, companion, garden
notes: Clear capacity and price table. Dates May 2026.

organised_by: Wahlgrab (Einzeltief, Mehrfach), Reihengrab, anonymes Grab, Gruft, Baumgrab, Urnenstele, Rasengrab, Felsengrab
notes: German grave tenure types with capacities (2 coffins or 4 urns per Einzeltiefgrab). Complements the ICCFA columbarium definition page.
